## Processing applied

| Step | Where | Note |
|---|---|---|
| loop points | `src/core/audio.js` | ambience layers loop with a randomised start offset so the station never repeats in phase |
| pitch variance | `src/core/audio.js` | ±2–3% per one-shot, so repeated sounds are never identical |
| distance / panning | WebAudio `PannerNode` | inverse rolloff, positioned in world space |
| interior ↔ exterior | two filtered buses | the exterior bus is low-passed to 750 Hz when the player is inside, the interior bus to 1400 Hz when outside |
| ducking | `Audio.duck()` | ambience drops under phone calls and radio |
| phone / radio / tape colouring | `Audio.voice()` | band-pass and low-pass profiles applied to human recordings |
| subtraction | `Audio.subtract()` | named layers are *removed* from the mix as a horror event |

All processing is done at runtime on the original CC0 files; the files
themselves are unmodified downloads, so the licence and provenance of each
shipped byte is exactly what the table above states.

## Sources considered and rejected

| Source | Why not used |
|---|---|
| Pixabay | blocks automated access (HTTP 403); could not verify per-file licences |
| BBC Sound Effects library | licence forbids redistribution inside a game build |
| Any "game rip" archive | prohibited outright |
| Synthesised/AI audio | prohibited by the project's own rules |
